title: Health Education and Promotion: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
programme: Diploma in Community Health and HIV Management
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B

items.text: Distinguish between health education and health promotion.
Briefly outline the characteristics of adult learners.
Outline the various methods that are used to organize a community for a health education program.
Briefly describe the six principles of planning in health education.
Briefly outline the resources that may be required to carry out a health promotion program.
Outline the steps undertaken in the learning process.
List and briefly describe the four main categories of barriers to learning.
Outline the steps that may be taken while preparing for an organized health talk.
List and briefly describe the various methods used in health education.
Describe the principles of community participation as applied in health promotion.
List and describe the principles of communication.

programmes: Diploma in Community Health and HIV Management
